audit_type: Read-only verification of saved S4 artifacts; no new training

negative_area_patient_bootstrap.statistic: Mean study false-area percentage difference, experiment minus control; resample patient clusters
negative_area_patient_bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive only with seven negative patients; interval spans zero. Positive-study bootstrap does not establish significant negative-area reduction.

qualifications: Recall point estimate decreases about 0.40 percentage points versus control. A confidence interval spanning zero does not prove noninferiority.
Full validation cohort has 136 unique patients; 132 refers to positive-study patients only.
21% reduction describes mean native false-pixel count; reduction in mean image-area percentage is about 18%.
Hard pool is scored by the older S2 model; this is a fixed S2-mined pool, not refreshed S3 mining.
Repeated development evaluation and one training seed do not establish external generalization.
recommended_next_step: Preserve S4 results. Retain/retry the same effective batch and augmentation after AMP skips before advancing to the next batch. Verify successful-update parity, predefine coverage-loss tolerance, and then run a second matched seed from the same frozen S3 checkpoint and fixed hard pool.
